title: GeoNames countryInfo rows absent from current UN M49 alpha-code table
disposition_policy: Keep source identifiers immutable. Distinguish current searchable destination areas from historical former entities. Destination selection is a geographic product behavior and does not assert sovereignty, treaty status, immigration eligibility, or statistical treatment.

records.m49_disposition: No separate current country/area row in the live M49 overview; UNSD FAQ says Kosovo is considered part of Serbia (M49 688) for M49 purposes and code 412 may be used for strictly statistical purposes.
records.iso_code_policy: Do not map XK/XKX/0 into ISO fields. Preserve these values only in source identifiers; do not treat M49 statistical code 412 as ISO numeric-3.
records.relationship_policy: Do not silently merge the destination area into the Serbia country identity. If statistical rollups are needed, record a separately typed source/statistical association with explicit provenance.

records.m49_disposition: No separate current country/area row in the live M49 overview; UNSD FAQ says Taiwan Province of China is treated within China (M49 156) for M49 purposes, while 158 may be used for strictly statistical purposes.
records.iso_code_policy: Retain the source tuple and corroborating ISO 3166 newsletter evidence with provenance; the audit has not downloaded the live ISO OBP/Code Collection, so ISO source-refresh verification remains an explicit periodic review.
records.relationship_policy: Keep Taiwan as an independently searchable geographic destination record. Do not infer or encode a sovereignty relationship from this destination-selectability decision. Do not treat M49 grouping as a Job Grid place-identity parent.

records.m49_disposition: Historical former entity. UNSD records that Serbia and Montenegro formally dissolved on 3 June 2006 into Serbia (M49 688) and Montenegro (M49 499).
records.iso_code_policy: The CS/SCG/891 tuple is retained as historical source metadata only; it must not be used as a current ISO country code tuple.
records.relationship_policy: Historical context only, not an active parent, merge, redirect to a single successor, or selectable destination.

records.m49_disposition: Historical former entity. UNSD says the Netherlands Antilles federation was formally dissolved on 10 October 2010; Aruba separated earlier in 1986.
records.iso_code_policy: The AN/ANT/530 tuple is preserved in historical source identifiers only, not in current ISO fields.

historical_successor_context.name: Aruba
historical_successor_context.note: Separated in 1986; do not imply it was first created at the 2010 dissolution.

records.relationship_policy: Historical reference only. The successor context is not a universal parent edge; post-2010 constitutional arrangements differ between the islands.
